name: BSP_EntityIdTable_Reset
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_entity_identity, read-only analysis. __fastcall(table), RET 0, body 00951560-00951614. Rebuilds the slot array at +4Ch: slot i carries the u16 id firstId+i at +8h, slot 0 is written with the literal id 0 and left out of every list, the free list runs head *(this+1Ch)=&slot[count-1] down to tail *(this+10h)=&slot[1], and the live list at +2Ch is emptied by pointing *(this+3Ch) at its own terminator. Called by the constructor 00951660 and per mission at 004E01E8/004E01F2 (BSP_Game_LoadMissionScene) and 004E3F27/004E3F31 (BSP_Game_OnInit). docs/ENTITY_IDENTITY.md

name: BSP_EntityIdTable_RebuildFreeList
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_entity_identity, read-only analysis. __fastcall(table), RET 0; the exhaustion path called from 009517C6 when the free count is 0. For i = count-1 down to 1, a slot whose entity pointer is null is relinked onto the free list at +1Ch. The occupancy test at 00951737 uses the raw index i while the relink at 00951741 uses i - firstId, so the two agree only for the table whose first id is 0; provisional original defect. docs/ENTITY_IDENTITY.md

name: BSP_EntityIdTable_Allocate
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_entity_identity, read-only analysis. __thiscall(table, uint16 requestedId, void* entity) -> uint16 in AX, RET 8 at 0095181B. Moves one 10h slot of the table at +4Ch from a free list to the live list at +3Ch: requestedId 0 pops the free list tail *(this+10h) and returns the id already in that slot (009517D7), a non-zero requestedId addresses slots+(id-first)*10h unchecked (009517DD). Stores the entity at slot+0Ch (009517F2) and decrements the free count +50h. Sole caller 009286E4 in BSP_GameEntity_Construct. The second argument is a requested id, not a creation flag. docs/ENTITY_IDENTITY.md

name: BSP_Unit_SetVehicleClass
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(instance, descriptor), RET 4. Refcounted setter for the vehicle-class descriptor at instance+538h: addrefs the new value through [00ce221c], releases the old through [00ce2220] and runs its deleting destructor when the release reports zero. See docs/SCENE_UNIT_CREATORS.md. | Packet cc2_unit_instance_layout: 009553DB early-outs when the new descriptor equals the old, so the field is never re-addrefed. The release path at 0095540B calls the old descriptor's vtable[0] with ECX = old and NO stack argument, so that slot is a plain virtual release, not a scalar deleting destructor taking a flag. The field it sets, +538h, is cleared by 0095CC90 from that constructor's third argument. docs/UNIT_INSTANCE_LAYOUT.md

name: BSP_VehicleClass_IsEnemyOfLocalParty
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. docs/VEHICLE_CLASS_DESCRIPTORS.md. __fastcall(int classIndex). Returns byte[registry[4010h] + classIndex*3 + localParty] == 0, where localParty is *(*(00E188A8 + 18CCh + *(00E188A8+18ECh)*4) + 28h) and the whole routine short-circuits to a zero-extended value unless *(00E188A8+18ECh) is in [0,8). True therefore means the local player's party has NOT registered a need for this class, which is why 00964790 selects the enemy_ prefix (00D1A954) on true and own_ (00D1A94C) on false. It reads the bitmap 0095BA60 writes, and grows it through 004359E0 the same way.
